title: What Does History Add? Calendar Controls and Information-Timing Audits for University Trajectory Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.21419v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We audit the predictive value of historical summaries in a rule-based university trajectory simulator. Seventeen ridge specifications and persistence separate current plans, past-state and past-plan summaries, and calendar-only history-length indicators. Across training, validation and two family-held-out evaluations, we reconstruct 16,750 routes and 804,000 monthly records. On the original 40-family set, six-month history lowers six-step normalized RMSE from 0.159234 to 0.151522, but its difference from a length-only control is -0.000895 (descriptive paired 95% interval [-0.001957,0.000248]). Fixed weights on 30 families unused in identified prior tasks reproduce this pattern: 0.156480 to 0.150074 versus current-state prediction, but -0.000558 [-0.001783,0.000728] versus the length control. These uncertain comparisons do not generalize to all-history summaries, which improve on their own calendar control. Exploratory decomposition finds

translated_title: 历史能带来什么？面向大学轨迹预测的日历控制与信息时机审计
translated_abstract: 我们审计了基于规则的大学轨迹模拟器中历史摘要的预测价值。通过十七种岭回归设定和持久性基线，我们将当前计划、过去状态与过去计划摘要，以及仅含日历信息的历史长度指标分离开来。在训练、验证以及两次按家族留出的评估中，我们共重建了16,750条路线和804,000条月度记录。在原始的40个家族集合上，六个月历史将六步归一化RMSE从0.159234降至0.151522，但其相对于仅长度控制的差异为-0.000895（描述性配对95%区间[-0.001957,0.000248]）。在使用先前任务中未涉及的30个家族的固定权重评估中重现了这一模式：相对于当前状态预测从0.156480降至0.150074，但相对于长度控制为-0.000558 [-0.001783,0.000728]。这些不确定的比较结果不能推广到全历史摘要，后者在其自身的日历控制上确有改进。探索性分解发现……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究通过严格的日历长度控制与信息时机审计发现，大学轨迹预测中六个月历史摘要相比仅使用历史长度指标并无显著的额外预测增益，但全历史摘要确实优于其对应的日历控制。
en_tdlr: Using calendar controls and information-timing audits, this study finds that six-month historical summaries offer no significant predictive gain over a length-only control in university trajectory forecasting, whereas all-history summaries do improve over their own calendar control.
